PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO ISSUE AND REGISTRATION
OF STOCK
patois    6. (1) Stock issued under this Act shall be issued on behalf

approved by the Minister, and shall be authenticated either
by the signature of the Governor, or by a facsimile of such

(2) Stock issued under this Act shall be in such form as
the Governor may from time to time approve.

Refusalof 7, Any application to take up stock issued under this Act
application. may be refused by the Governor without reason assigned.

oreree™ Tegister to be kept for the purpose by the Bank in such form

(2) All stock issued under this Act, and the right to receive
the principal moneys and interest represented thereby, shall
be Ransrerable by an instrument of transfer registered by
the Bank.

(3) No stock issued under this Act shall be registered
except in the name of an individual person or persons or of
a corporation.

9. (1) The interest upon the principal moneys represented
by stock issued under this Act shall be paid half-yearly at
the office of the Bank.

(2) The Minister shall, in each half-yearly period ending
with the day on which interest on stock issued under this
Act falls due, appropriate out of the Consolidated Fund
a sum equal to one-half year's interest on the whole of the
stock so issued in order that the interest for such half year
may be paid therefrom.

10. The Minister may fix such fee as he considers reasonable
for the performance by the Bank of any powers or duties
conferred or imposed under this Act, and the fee so fixed
is hereby charged on and appropriated out of the Consoli-
dated fund.

PART IV
PROVISIONS RELATING TO REDEMPTION OF STOCK

11. Stock issued under this Act shall be redeemable at par
on such dates as may be specified in the prospectus, after
which dates all the interest on the principal moneys repre-
sented thereby shall cease and determine, whether payment
of such principal moneys shall have been demanded or not.

12. The repayment of all principal moneys represented by
stock issued under this Act at the time when the same
become due shall be made by the Minister out of the
Consolidated Fund.

13. Before the repayment of the principal moneys repre-
sented by any stock issued under this Act, such stock shall
be delivered up for cancellation to the Bank.

PART V
GENERAL

(3) Whenever a depositor gives notice that he wishes the
whole or part of the advance deposits made by him to be
repaid, such deposits or part thereof made by such depositor
shall be repaid immediately, but no interest shall be payable
thereon.

(4) Advance deposits which are applied to the purchase
of stock in accordance with sub-section (2) shall carry
interest at the rate applicable to such stock calculated from
the date the deposit was received by the Bank, and such
interest shall be charged on the Consolidated Fund and
